description: 福祉避難所一覧 [evacuation shelters and public facilities] (series on BODIK ODCS) is a series of datasets listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by BODIK (Open Data Catalogue Service of Japanese local governments). 大規模災害などで避難生活が長期化するおそれがあり、高齢や障害などの理由で、コミュニティセンターや小学校などの指定避難所での生活が困難な方のために、市が開設する二次的な避難所です。 災害発生時に最初から開設される避難所ではありません。 まずはお近くに開設された指定避難所に避難をお願いいたします。. Coverage: Japan. The portal lists 4 near-identical datasets in this series (one per municipality, prefecture, year, month or site), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The datasets are filed under 4 publishers. Its tags are 位置情報, 福祉, 緯度経度, 避難所. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2020-10-13 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
